name: dnp3
title: DNP3: opendnp3 vs dnp3-rs
summary: Differential + sanitizer fuzzing of opendnp3 (C++, the target) against the dnp3 crate (Rust, Step Function I/O) on the DNP3 link/transport/application decode path. Stateful trace op reassembles transport segments across link frames. Both libraries are maintained by one vendor, so the Rust side is a strong oracle.
